content: Refined nexus resonates. Hold it near an active kinetic network and the hum changes — a beat frequency, like two realities slightly out of phase.
Your instruments insist there is only one reality here. Your instruments are wrong, or they are lying, or they were built by someone who wanted you to think so.
The resonance points somewhere. Not up. Not down. Somewhere else — past a boundary you cannot see yet.
Further research may find the way through. The Codex will record what you find. If you come back.
title: Layers Beneath
